test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 6% per annum rate of interest for the period from 19 February 2024 to 20 April 2024.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

Time Period = From 19 February 2024 to 20 April 2024

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

Total days = 31 (March) + 20 (April) + (29 February - 19 February) = 61 days

Time (T) = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 years

SI = (4,000 × 6 × 1/6) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 4,000 ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 40

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**
